IRS990.ActivityOrMissionDesc: Advancing Compassion Project is organized to provide charitable and educational assistance to the public by bringing financial support and increasing community awareness to individuals and oranizations helping the underserved or providing other charitable or educational benefit to the public.
IRS990.MissionDesc: Advancing Compassion Project is a volunteer-based nonprofit dedicated to bringing support and increased community awareness to organizations and individuals helping the under-served.
IRS990.Desc: ProPhilanthropy program. The ProPhilanthropy program provided funds to low-income and disadvantaged individuals and small groups to promote self-sufficiency through establishment or growth of an income activity or obtaining vocational, educational or other training. In a number of cases in which individuals were successful, a portion of the funds were paid back to ProPhilanthropy and these were then used to fund other individuals. During the fiscal year, a total of $224,225 was paid out in expenses and $215,976 was paid back which was then used in the funding of others.

SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: The ProPhilanthropy program provided funds to low-income and disadvantaged individuals and small groups to promote self-sufficiency through establishment or growth of an income activity or obtaining vocational, educational or other training; these activities are carried out by CARE, Kiva, Milaap, and their partners. Grants take the form of small microfinance funding. Monitoring use of the funds takes place via the Internet platforms provided by CARE, Kiva, and Milaap; which track and report on an ongoing basis.
